fixes.area: pedestrian density in the hero views
fixes.problem: Walkers on screen fell r7 -> r8: hero 4 -> 2, hero_back 4 -> 2, hero_night 4 -> 2, hero_noon 3 -> 2. The promenade at EQ at golden hour reads deserted. S.clearView (peds.js line 66) now only relocates people who are in the sightline; nobody tops the view up, and the desktop eq loop holds just 16 walkers along ~400 m of shore (line 55), so the 60 m in front of the camera averages 2.
fixes.fix: peds.js: (1) eq walkers high 16 -> 24, landing 8 -> 10 (these zones are inside the planar mirror anyway; cost is skinned draws only when VIS_R hits). (2) At the end of S.clearView add a top-up: count walkers p with 8 < dist(cam) < 60 m and dot(normalize(p - cam), camFwd) > 0.6; while count < VIEW_TOPUP, take the nearest walker of zones eq/landing that is outside that cone and teleport it to a random waypoint w from the same filter clearView already uses for 'far' (dp > 6, dl 10..60, cos > 0.6, cd > 3), set p.wp, randomise yaw along the loop. (3) Spread them: reject w if another walker is within 4 m. Same top-up runs once per 2 s in normal play when the player is on foot and stationary, so gameplay frames match the shots.

Sampling step 10 -> 8 m, min gap 14 -> 9 m; placed cap ceil(0.8*target) -> target. T.target high 18 -> 26. Add a parked-car row: for every road of cls 't' or 'p' with a footpath, one car per 6.5 m kerb slot at 50% occupancy, as one InstancedMesh per KINDS body (no AI, no physics, castShadow true, noReflect true); hide instances > 260 m. peds.js S.prime: Math.random() > 0.7 skip -> > 0.95 and cos 0.55 -> 0.35 so sgt walkers land on the visible footpaths.
